bead.title: Add hybrid-async crash and perf matrix gates to TP-003
bead.description:
PROBLEM: TP-003 has hybrid-async success-barrier coverage, but the release gate still lacks an explicit crash matrix and perf matrix acceptance set for hybrid-async.

ROOT CAUSE: `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md:209` defines the general object-log crash-point matrix, `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md:211` defines hybrid-async success-barrier replay, and `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md:332` defines hot-read performance, but the artifact does not require a named hybrid-async crash matrix and perf matrix that combine ordered batching, lag, lineage, retention-frontier, and release-lane hot-path evidence.

PROPOSED FIX: Update governing artifact `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md` to add or extend acceptance criteria for the hybrid-async crash matrix and perf matrix. Require crash coverage around manifest commit, memory apply/render, async SQLite apply, partial SQLite batch transactions, restart, replay, and high-water recovery. Require perf-matrix fields for ordered batching, high-water, lineage, retention frontier, async lag, replay contract, release-lane hot-path comparison, and evidence that WAL/fsync/checkpoint state is not treated as logical high-water or retention authority.

NON-SCOPE: Code changes; implementing metrics, repair tools, or performance tests; changing existing evidence results; changes outside the four governing artifact references; altering existing dependency ID `pqueue-b207e65d`; weakening the required verification commands; editing `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md` except as a separate child bead.

DEPENDENCY: parent `pqueue-b207e65d`.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestHybridAsyncPlanCrashPerfMatrix: `rg -n 'hybrid-async|crash matrix|perf matrix|ordered batching|sqlite_high_water|lineage|retention_frontier|async SQLite lag|replay contract|release-lane|hot path' docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md` succeeds and shows hybrid-async crash matrix and perf matrix gates with the required evidence fields.
2. TestHybridAsyncPlanCrashPerfNoEvidenceMutation: `git diff --name-only` after the bead contains only `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md`.
3. TestHybridAsyncPlanCrashPerfCargoGate: `cargo test -p pqueue-release ledger_path_honors_env_override_and_default` passes.
4. TestHybridAsyncPlanCrashPerfFmtGate: `cargo fmt --check` passes.
5. TestHybridAsyncPlanCrashPerfGoGate: `go test ./...` passes or records a no-Go-module skip with the exact command output.
6. TestHybridAsyncPlanCrashPerfLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
